report_title: Final Regression and System Evaluation Report

executive_summary.readiness_assessment: BETA / PILOT READY (Core retrieval, reranking, filtering, and parser caching verified; catalog coverage and tag enrichment required before production release)
executive_summary.offline_reproducibility: 100% verified (no external API keys required for test suite or evaluation runs)

movie.alignment: 1-to-1 verified between ChromaDB collection and clean metadata

key_accomplishments: Discovered 4,806 vs 4,805 row discrepancy between movies.pkl and movie_metadata_clean.csv; established movies1234.pkl as canonical aligned dataset.
Verified ChromaDB persistent storage at data/chroma_db containing all 4 entertainment collections.
Established baseline pytest suite with 4 passing schema and integrity tests.

fixes_implemented: Fixed module-level Groq client instantiation crash when GROQ_API_KEY is not set.
Added parser evaluation runner with deterministic cache fingerprinting and semantic ordering.
Resolved TypeError when comparing string values against numeric boundaries (e.g. Goodreads page counts).
Enforced strict exclusion of missing/null values under active constraints.
Implemented TMDB cast and director concatenated name normalization (e.g., 'JamesCameron' vs 'James Cameron').
Implemented ISBN token normalization and Spotify duration unit conversions.
Added boundary-inclusive numeric filtering with type safety across all domains.

architecture.pre_filtering: Direct vector dot-product scoring for selective candidate sets (len <= 250)

identical_dense_and_rrf_metrics.explanation: BM25 and Dense retrieval produced different candidate sets in 7 of the 12 queries, and RRF altered candidate rankings accordingly. However, on the 12-query benchmark, for queries where relevant items were found (MOV_003, ANI_001, MUS_002), both Dense and RRF placed the targets at the identical top positions (#1, #4-#5, and top 5 respectively). For queries where the relevant targets were outside top-K, both scored 0.0. The metrics diverged significantly only upon Cross-Encoder reranking.

absence_query_handling.explanation: Previously, correct empty returns on negative queries (RET_BOOK_002) were credited as positive hits. In Phase 5, absence detection is decoupled from positive ranking metrics, reporting Correct Rejection Rate (1.0 = 100%) with an explicit positive query denominator of N=11.

benchmark_scope.explanation: The 12-query retrieval benchmark covers representative scenarios across all media types, but is a targeted regression set rather than an exhaustive statistical evaluation.

defect_classification.title: Movie title omitted from original preprocessing tags
defect_classification.impact: Unconstrained BM25 and raw dense retrieval struggle with exact movie title keywords unless metadata filtering or selective vector scoring is triggered.
defect_classification.mitigation_status: MITIGATED: search_black_knight extracts title into metadata filter, enabling selective direct vector scoring on valid_ids.
defect_classification.recommended_fix: Prepend film title to tag column in future index rebuilding.

defect_classification.title: Missing popular catalog items (e.g. Paulo Coelho's The Alchemist)
defect_classification.impact: Queries for popular works absent from the 11k Goodreads sample return 0 items.
defect_classification.mitigation_status: MITIGATED: Absence detection returns clean empty results without hallucinating irrelevant items.
defect_classification.recommended_fix: Ingest complete open-library or larger Goodreads dumps in future expansions.

defect_classification.title: Sparse book character metadata
defect_classification.impact: Filtering by secondary characters is limited by metadata nulls.
defect_classification.mitigation_status: CONFIRMED: Filter safely excludes rows where character metadata is null.
defect_classification.recommended_fix: Enrich book dataset using Wikidata entity linkage.

defect_classification.title: Missing anime ranking / popularity values in raw dataset
defect_classification.impact: Unranked or newly aired anime lack ranking values.
defect_classification.mitigation_status: CONFIRMED: Handled via null-safe numeric boundary checks.
defect_classification.recommended_fix: Periodic sync with MyAnimeList / AniList APIs.

defect_classification.title: Music genre routing misalignment in query parser
defect_classification.impact: Parser normalized match rate for music is 20% due to playlist_genre vs playlist_subgenre routing differences.
defect_classification.mitigation_status: DOCUMENTED: Metadata filter supports cross-matching across genre and subgenre.
defect_classification.recommended_fix: Update system prompt with Spotify genre taxonomy few-shot examples.
